exposure: Gestational hypothyroidism (GHT) in pregnant women with preeclampsia
Maternal liver function indicators (e.g., alanine aminotransferase/ALT levels)
cohort: The study utilized data from 420 pregnant women with preeclampsia who underwent prenatal examinations and delivery at an Obstetrics department.
finding: Neonates born to pregnant women with preeclampsia combined with gestational hypothyroidism (GHT) exhibited significantly lower birth weights and a higher incidence of low birth weight compared to those with preeclampsia alone, with maternal alanine aminotransferase (ALT) levels partially mediating this association.
birth_weight: The median (interquartile range) birth weight of all neonates was 2990.0 (2541.3, 3368.8) grams.
